metadataReview.note: Åsnes municipality identifies the battle on 25 April 1808 in the Trangen valley between Kjellåsen and Butteråsen. The point is Kartverket's published representative position of that named valley, rounded for atlas display, not a surveyed battle centre or deployment. The cemetery at Åsnes church and Sønsterud farm, where the wounded Dreyer later died, are separate places and are not used as the combat location. The existing date is retained without calendar conversion.

note:
The municipal historical account identifies opposing Norwegian and Swedish forces at Trangen during the Denmark–Norway versus Sweden war of 1808. These are two event-local forces, not modern state identities or an assertion of homogeneous infantry. No army-wide mobilisation total, campaign strength, prisoner count, deaths or casualties is imported. All quantities remain unknown; no equipment identity or model profile is assigned. The existing event source is retained.
